name: reauthenticate-card
title: Reauthenticate card
description: 'Confirm it is you' before a sensitive action, in a card or a dialog: it names what is about to happen, then takes a password or a passkey.
docs: email says who is signed in (an initials avatar, or avatar as an image address) and action what is about to happen, in a few words: Change your email address, Delete this workspace. onConfirm(password) returns an error message or nothing: the message is announced once, against the field, which keeps the focus and empties itself for the next try; counting attempts and locking are the server's job, and the card shows whatever message you return (a throw shows a general one). onPasskey is the second route, Use a passkey instead: you own the WebAuthn call, and a returned message shows above the field. onCancel adds a Cancel button next to Confirm, and grace is the line about how long the answer holds (You will not be asked again for 10 minutes), so people do not feel nagged. The button that was pressed keeps the focus, also when the passkey fails. After success the button shows Confirmed and the card stays still. defaultError starts with a message under the field, for a preview. Inside a dialog, set titleAs to p, give the dialog its own title, drop the frame with className (border-0 shadow-none) and pass titleId if you want aria-labelledby to point at the card's heading.
